collectionMethod: Manual capture around 10:36 Beijing time / 02:36Z on 2026-11-23 of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which 301-redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, which 302-redirects to /console/go), the documentation markdown export (https://opencode.ai/docs/console/go.md), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models). All surfaces were compared against the 2026-11-21 captures of the same URLs (the 2026-11-22 routine scan did not complete, so the 2026-11-21 capture is used as the baseline). Every price, limit, estimate and sentence below is transcribed as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed, no chart or site change.
scope: OpenCode Go official catalog only. The change on 2026-11-23 is that a new paid model 'LongCat 2.5' appeared in the official OpenCode Go catalog, and the two previously listed LongCat rows (longcat-2.0 and longcat-2.5-free) are no longer published on the models API or the landing page. The models API count moved 31 → 30 and the landing-page counter moved 'View all 32 models' → 'View all 31 models'. No leaderboard/score data, no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance, no script change in this file.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no opencode_go × longcat-2.5 row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires an OPENCODE_GO_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py, left to maintainer review

paidModel.statusChange: On 2026-11-23 the models API published a new paid catalog entry 'LongCat-2.5' (model id longcat-2.5) and the Go landing-page model table published a new row 'LongCat 2.5' carrying the 'New' and 'Limited regions' labels. The models API count moved 31 → 30 and the landing-page counter moved 'View all 32 models' → 'View all 31 models'.

regionConsistencyConflict.observation: The models API go block publishes limited_regions = false for longcat-2.5, while the Go landing-page row carries a 'Limited regions' label and the official documentation states 'LongCat 2.5: Hosted in China. regionConsistencyConflict.note: Both readings are recorded exactly as published on their own surface. This file does not adjudicate which surface is authoritative; the conflict is left for maintainer review.

modelsApi.note: The models API returned 30 model entries on 2026-11-23 versus 31 in the 2026-11-21 capture.

modelCount.changeArithmetic: The models API net change is −1: longcat-2.0 and longcat-2.5-free were removed from the published catalog and longcat-2.5 was added. This is a description of the published list lengths as captured, not a computed adopted value.

replacedModels.note: Both LongCat rows that were still published in the 2026-11-21 capture are no longer present on the 2026-11-23 models API or the Go landing-page model table. The delisting is recorded here as evidence only; the decision to drop the corresponding adopted rows is left to upstream per the established convention.
